AGRICULTURE — TERMLY EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

2. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Producers
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Tertiary consumers

3. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 37 °C

4. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Integrated Farming? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Integrated Farming.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Integrated Farming.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Integrated Farming.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Integrated Farming.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Leftover Food? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Leftover Food.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Leftover Food.

   D. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Leftover Food.

   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures.

10. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Storage of Crop Produce? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Storage of Crop Produce.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Storage of Crop Produce.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Storage of Crop Produce.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Storage of Crop Produce.

   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Gr.

13. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Paper burning to ash

14. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Heating until a solid melts

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos? (1 mark)
